record.name: Bothan
record.description: Canny and connected, Bothans excel at information networks, subterfuge, and leverage through favors owed and granted.

innate_traits.name: Many Bothans
innate_traits.narrative: The Bothan saying 'Many Bothans died to bring us this information' reflects your species' deep commitment to information networks and mutual support.

mechanics.name: Network Contact
mechanics.description: Once per short rest, you can call upon your network contacts to gain advantage on a social check.

innate_traits.name: Shadowstep
innate_traits.narrative: Your species has mastered the art of moving unseen through urban environments, blending seamlessly into crowds and shadows.

mechanics.description: You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to blend into crowds or urban environments.

innate_traits.name: Fur Communication
innate_traits.narrative: Your fur can convey subtle emotional cues and information, allowing for silent communication with other Bothans.

mechanics.description: You have advantage on Deception checks when communicating with other Bothans.

appearance_profile.llm_description_prompt: Describe a Bothan character. Emphasize their sharp, calculating eyes and graceful, confident movements. Their fur should reflect their social status and background. Consider their natural elegance and the subtle ways they gather information and influence others through their presence and demeanor.

class_synergies.narrative: Bothans are masters of espionage. Their natural cunning and societal focus on information networks make them the quintessential Operative.
mechanical_benefits: Shadowstep trait enhances stealth in populated areas

class_synergies.narrative: A Bothan's charm and ability to navigate complex social and political webs align perfectly with the Scoundrel's life of negotiation and intrigue.
mechanical_benefits: High Charisma enhances persuasion and deception
Many Bothans trait supports urban-based scoundrel activities
Natural social intelligence aids in criminal networks

class_synergies.narrative: Bothans' natural diplomatic abilities and extensive information networks make them exceptional Consulars, able to broker deals and gather intelligence simultaneously.
mechanical_benefits: Information network background aids in negotiations

class_synergies.narrative: Bothans' analytical minds and access to vast information networks make them excellent Scholars, particularly in political science and intelligence analysis.
mechanical_benefits: High Charisma aids in research and information gathering
Network connections provide access to rare knowledge

faction_synergies.narrative: The Bothan Spynet is the most extensive intelligence network in the galaxy, with Bothans serving as its primary agents and information brokers.
Many Bothans support the Rebellion through their intelligence networks, providing crucial information while maintaining plausible deniability.
Bothans excel in corporate espionage and business intelligence, using their networks to gain competitive advantages and broker deals.

species_progression.base_description: Your species excels at information networks and social manipulation. You gain proficiency in Deception or Persuasion and can call upon contacts for advantages.

level_5.description: Your information network has grown more extensive. You can access deeper levels of intelligence and call in more significant favors.

level_10.description: Your network connections have become legendary. You can access secret information and call in major favors from powerful contacts.

mechanical_effect.description: Once per long rest, you can access secret information or call in a major favor from your network contacts

level_15.description: You have become a master of information networks. Your ability to gather and manipulate information is unparalleled.

mechanical_effect.description: Once per long rest, you can access any piece of non-classified information or call in a legendary favor

level_20.description: You are a living legend of information networks. Your web of contacts spans the entire galaxy, and your influence is unmatched.

mechanical_effect.description: Once per long rest, you can access any information or call in any favor, regardless of classification or difficulty

narrative_progression.level_5: At this point, you've honed your skills as a Bothan operative and have access to advanced information networks. Your reputation among other Bothans grows, and you begin to attract attention from key factions within the Spynet.
narrative_progression.level_10: You've reached a position of influence within the Bothan community, with many looking up to you for guidance and support. You're able to call in favors from high-ranking officials and gain access to sensitive information that would be unavailable to lesser operatives.
narrative_progression.level_15: Your skills as a master spy have earned you recognition across the galaxy, with both allies and enemies taking notice of your exceptional abilities. You begin to receive offers for high-stakes missions, leveraging your reputation to secure lucrative contracts and further your own interests.
narrative_progression.level_20: As one of the most renowned Bothan operatives in the galaxy, you've achieved a level of mastery that's unmatched by your peers. Your connections are vast, and your influence reaches into the highest echelons of power. You're able to manipulate events from behind the scenes, using your knowledge and resources to shape the course of galactic history.

cultural_features.activation: When seeking information about political events, military movements, or corporate activities
cultural_features.description: Your connections to the Bothan Spynet provide access to a vast information network spanning the galaxy.
cultural_features.name: Spynet Connections
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: You can call in favors from Bothan contacts, access secret information networks, and leverage your species' reputation for gathering intelligence.

cultural_features.activation: When communicating with other Bothans or in situations requiring subtle coordination
cultural_features.description: Your species' unique ability to communicate through subtle fur movements allows for silent coordination and emotional expression.
cultural_features.name: Fur Communication
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: You can convey complex emotions and information through subtle fur movements, allowing for silent coordination and deep emotional connections with other Bothans.

cultural_features.activation: When attempting to move unnoticed through urban environments or crowds
cultural_features.description: Your training in the ancient Bothan art of moving unseen through shadows and blending into crowds.
cultural_features.name: Shadowstep Tradition
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: You can blend seamlessly into crowds, move through shadows like a ghost, and disappear into the urban landscape with practiced ease.

cultural_features.activation: When working with other Bothans or accessing shared information
cultural_features.description: The Bothan saying 'Many Bothans died to bring us this information' reflects your species' deep commitment to information sharing and mutual support.
cultural_features.name: Many Bothans Network
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: You can tap into the collective knowledge and resources of the Bothan community, sharing information and receiving support from your network.

cultural_networks.name: Bothan Spynet
cultural_networks.description: A network of interconnected information brokers and operatives who share intelligence and coordinate efforts.

cultural_networks.name: Bothan Cultural Networks
cultural_networks.description: A loose association of Bothans who maintain connections through subtle fur movements, emotional expression, and silent coordination.

traditional_practices.name: Shadowstep Tradition
traditional_practices.description: An ancient art of moving unseen through shadows and blending into crowds.

traditional_practices.name: Many Bothans Network
traditional_practices.description: The collective knowledge and resources shared among the Bothan community.

cultural_knowledge.name: Spynet Connections
cultural_knowledge.description: Your access to a vast information network spanning the galaxy.

cultural_knowledge.name: Fur Communication
cultural_knowledge.description: Your ability to convey complex emotions and information through subtle fur movements.

environmental_adaptations.advantage: Natural expertise in urban environments and social navigation
environmental_adaptations.immersion_effect: You move through urban environments with natural ease, your species' evolutionary adaptation to city life making you perfectly at home in crowded streets and bustling markets.

environmental_adaptations.advantage: Expertise in corporate environments and business intelligence
environmental_adaptations.immersion_effect: Your natural understanding of corporate politics and business dynamics allows you to navigate boardrooms and office environments with practiced ease.

environmental_adaptations.advantage: Mastery of political environments and diplomatic intelligence
environmental_adaptations.immersion_effect: Your species' natural aptitude for politics and diplomacy makes you perfectly suited for navigating complex political landscapes and gathering sensitive information.

environmental_adaptations.advantage: Enhanced ability to navigate and manipulate social networks
environmental_adaptations.immersion_effect: Your natural understanding of social dynamics and network building allows you to create and manipulate complex webs of influence and information.

environmental_knowledge.name: Urban Environments
environmental_knowledge.description: You're familiar with navigating crowded streets, bustling markets, and urban landscapes.

environmental_knowledge.name: Corporate Environments
environmental_knowledge.description: Your understanding of corporate politics and business dynamics allows you to navigate boardrooms and office environments.

environmental_knowledge.name: Political Environments
environmental_knowledge.description: Your mastery of diplomatic intelligence and negotiations makes you suited for complex political landscapes.

survival_techniques.name: Stealth in Urban Environments
survival_techniques.description: You can blend seamlessly into crowds, move through shadows like a ghost, and disappear into the urban landscape with practiced ease.

emergence.description: You meet a Bothan with access to valuable information.
rewards: A lead on a high-priority mission

escalation.description: A Bothan infiltrator is discovered working for the opposing faction.
requirements: The Bothan's betrayal causes tension among allies
Your reputation as an information broker takes a hit

confrontation.description: A group of Bothans launch a surprise attack on your allies.
requirements: The uprising catches you off guard
Your alliances are strained due to the Bothan's actions
rewards: A valuable item from the Bothan's arsenal

resolution_paths.victory: You negotiate a peaceful resolution with the Bothans, improving your standing in their eyes.
resolution_paths.redemption: You make amends with the Bothans and gain back their trust.
resolution_paths.escape: You narrowly evade the Bothan uprising and flee to safety.

The Bothans launch a surprise attack on your allies.
You are tasked with infiltrating a Bothan gathering.

romance_compatibility: Bothans and humans have a complicated history.
The Bothan's cunning nature may clash with your own.
Your charisma-based abilities could be an asset in wooing the Bothan.

romance_progression.stage1: You strike up a conversation with the Bothan, discovering a shared interest.
romance_progression.stage2: The Bothan begins to open up to you, sharing their goals and motivations.
romance_progression.stage3: Your relationship deepens, and you find yourself considering the Bothan's feelings.
romance_progression.stage4: The Bothan confides in you about a personal issue, strengthening your bond.
romance_progression.stage5: You and the Bothan share a romantic moment, solidifying your connection.

romance_events: You share a tender moment with the Bothan during a mission.
The Bothan saves your life, earning your gratitude.
You uncover a deep-seated fear or insecurity in the Bothan, allowing you to offer comfort and support.
romance_modifiers: Your charisma score affects how well you connect with the Bothan.
The Bothan's cunning nature may make them more difficult to win over.

record.flavor_text: "A Bothan's word is their bond, and a debt unpaid is a wound that never heals. We trade in favors, not coins."

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: As a Bothan, you're adept at navigating complex webs of influence and information. Use your charisma to build relationships, gather intel, and manipulate situations to your advantage.
narrative_hooks: A high-stakes meeting with a powerful patron hangs in the balance.
A long-lost contact resurfaces with crucial information, but their loyalty is uncertain.
A valuable asset has gone missing, and you must track it down before rival agents do.
llm_guidance.social_dynamics: Bothans often walk a fine line between friend and foe. Cultivate your network of favors owed and granted to stay ahead in the game.

ai_behavior.combat_behavior: Use stealth and cunning to outmaneuver foes, then strike with precision.
ai_behavior.social_behavior: Bribe or manipulate others to achieve your goals, but always maintain a veneer of charm.
